claims.text: MITRE's Board of Trustees elected former Principal Deputy Director of National Intelligence Donald Kerr as chairman, reported 6 November 2018, at the same meeting that elected former Rep. Mike Rogers, ex-chairman of the House Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence, as vice chairman.

claims.locator: coverage of the 2018 MITRE trustee election
claims.sourceText: Public ODNI and NRO biographical record, as summarised in WashingtonExec's 2018 report on his MITRE election
claims.text: Kerr previously directed Los Alamos National Laboratory and the National Reconnaissance Office before becoming PDDNI.

edges.label: Directed Los Alamos before the NRO and ODNI
edges.note: The same individual later chaired MITRE's board - a single career spanning the contractor-operated weapons laboratory, national overhead reconnaissance, and the FFRDC now under records demand.

edges.label: Chairman of MITRE's Board of Trustees from November 2018
edges.note: Former director of Los Alamos National Laboratory, former director of the National Reconnaissance Office, former PDDNI - elected chairman at the same meeting that made Mike Rogers vice chairman.
